title: Sailing Sur le Vent

services.name: Thursday Night Race Watch
services.desc: Thursday night is the Havre de Grace Yacht Club's race night. 2 Hours About Come sailing with Sailing Sur le Vent and get an up close view of all the beautiful and colorful boats, be sure to bring your camera! Sailing Sur le Vent is offering a special race night watch cruise on an individual per person basis for up to 6 passengers. This is one one of the best deals of the season @ $75 per person but is strictly limited to 6 passengers, book now to reserve your spot. Departure is from Pier 2 at the Havre de Grace Yacht Basin promptly at 6pm, with a return at around 8:00 pm. Please Ages 13+ • 2 Hour • Enjoy all the action from a unique viewpoint - bring your camera!

services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Join us! About Sailing Sur le Vent offers day and sunset charters out of historic Havre de Grace, MD on the beautiful waters of the Chesapeake Bay. You are welcome to sit back, relax and let us do all the work, or if you prefer to try your hand at the wheel, the Captain will be happy to teach you the finer points of sailing a true bluewater Ages 16+ • 3.5 Hours • Price includes up to 4 people
